segments.text:
V. 21.
Wo to thee, Chorazin—That is, miſerable art thou. For theſe are not Curſes or Imprecations as has been commonly ſuppoſed; but a ſolemn, compaſſionate Declaration of the Miſery they were bringing on themſelves. Chorazin and Bethſaida were Cities of Galilee▪
ſtanding by the Lake of Genneſareth. Tyre and Sidon were Cities of Phenic•a, lying on the Sea-ſhore. The Inhabitants of them were Heathens.
